---
title: "JPEG open-graph image gets its measured size, not the site's declared size"
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/mark.jpg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="52">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="34">'
        - []
---

With `site-url` set, Quarto measures the JPEG and the measured size wins over the site's declared `image-width` and `image-height`.
